title: Light and Sleep Fragmentation
official: Application of Precision Medicine to Phototherapy: a Stepped Care Approach to Consolidate Sleep and Slow Cognitive Decline in Older Adults
summary: This trial will examine scheduled exposure to bright light in the morning and afternoon as a countermeasure to sleep fragmentation in older individuals with mild cognitive impairment.
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Mild Cognitive Impairment
* Age \>65

Exclusion Criteria:

* Severe depression
* Unstable psychiatric or medical disease
* Acute infection
